name: Visayas Championship 2018

venue.name: [Parkmall](http://www.parkmallcebu.com/)
venue.address: Ouano Avenue, North Reclamation Area Mandaue City, Cebu
venue.details: West Lobby in between First Family Appliance and Samsung

information: Registration fee(Inclusion: certificate of participation, ID and a KungFu QingHong 3x3x3) starts at Php 300.00 for the first 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event, this is up to March 31, 2018 only for the early bird. Regular base registration fee of Php 350 for 3 events will apply starting in April. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on May 13, 2018 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Requests for change of events are only allowed up to the registration cut-off. Strictly no refund and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event.
